name: CleanSweep
tagline: Swipe through your photos to clean up storage fast
description:
CleanSweep helps you take back storage space by making it fast to sort through your photos and videos. Swipe through your media one item at a time to decide what stays and what goes, similar to how you'd swipe through a dating app.

It also looks for duplicate and similar photos automatically, so you can spot near-identical shots and clear out the clutter without hunting for them yourself.
